Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl

Class AbstractStagingResourceResolver

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.AbstractStagingResourceResolver
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Closeable, AutoCloseable, org.apache.sling.api.adapter.Adaptable, org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    StagingResourceResolver, VersionSelectResourceResolver
    public abstract class AbstractStagingResourceResolver
extends Object
implements org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver
    Common methods for resource resolvers that present data from previous versions stored in the JCR content as normal resources.
